scope_coverage.name: Core Card & Rules Platform
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Versioned rules/catalog imports, immutable release artifacts and content provenance; public catalog CDN versus private certification records.

scope_coverage.name: Actual Match Engine
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Authoritative CPU match processes, transactions/journal/receipts, private RNG and viewer projections; reconnect/drain without instance affinity.

scope_coverage.name: Deckbuilder
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Authenticated relational deck storage, revision conflicts, indexes/search, exports and asset CDN; local deck editing remains responsive.

scope_coverage.name: Sandbox / Lab Mode
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Ownership-free Lab and separate manipulated Sandbox; bounded bots/simulations; admission/eligibility enforce reward policy.

scope_coverage.name: Player Collection
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Printing/finish-aware durable holdings, ledger, receipts and authoritative inventory; CDN art never substitutes for ownership records.

scope_coverage.name: Virtual Product System
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Transactional virtual packs/boxes/products and reveal receipts; client Babylon renders authored assets without cloud GPU.

scope_coverage.name: Progression & Economy
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Idempotent grants, integer ledger and durable jobs/outbox; rate controls and audit for free-player economy.

scope_coverage.name: Player Profile
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Profiles and preferences in relational storage; privacy/deletion, synchronized device settings and limited public fields.

scope_coverage.name: Matchmaking
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Transactional queue/admission, private ownership versus legality checks, clocks and connection recovery.

scope_coverage.name: Ranked System
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Ranked season/rating transactions, leaderboards, abuse review and retained eligible release versions.

scope_coverage.name: Limited Formats
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Draft/sealed/rush admission and product pools, timed draft sessions, durable choices and arrival-spike qualification.

scope_coverage.name: AI Opponents
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: CPU search/bot workers with concurrency/time budgets separate from live-match capacity; optional advanced AI unselected.

scope_coverage.name: Tutorial & Learning System
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Versioned tutorial/scenario assets and progress, deterministic teaching fixtures and accessibility checks.

scope_coverage.name: Rules Assistant
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Source-linked rules search/index and context; paid model APIs optional, separately approved and privacy-qualified.

scope_coverage.name: Match History & Replay System
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Authorized per-viewer replay objects, retained engine/rules/catalog versions, access/deletion and export expiry.

scope_coverage.name: Post-Game Analytics
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Asynchronous replay analysis and relational aggregates; job quotas and private/public data separation.

scope_coverage.name: Spectator System
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Spectator fan-out/delay, caster/judge scopes and hidden-state protection; distinct connection and egress allowance.

scope_coverage.name: Tournament Platform
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Tournament bursts, judge/admin authorization, bracket/result transactions and delayed replay retention.

scope_coverage.name: Social Features
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Friends/blocks/chat/invites and report queues; moderation ownership, rate limits and durable notifications.

scope_coverage.name: Card Encyclopedia
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Public encyclopedia/catalog search, relationships, version labels and licensed CDN assets.

scope_coverage.name: Metagame & Competitive Data
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Bounded aggregate statistics and scheduled refresh; privacy floors and certified-format filters.

scope_coverage.name: Deck Discovery
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Deck discovery/search/sharing with moderation and publication consent; PostgreSQL indexes before hosted search.

scope_coverage.name: Achievements
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Idempotent achievements and completion events through existing ledger/outbox patterns.

scope_coverage.name: Cosmetics
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Entitlements and cosmetic unlocks are durable; CDN audio/table/card assets and client rendering budgets.

scope_coverage.name: Accessibility & User Experience
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Browser/device accessibility, localization and reduced motion; network/CDN latency plus interruption recovery, actual hardware tests.

scope_coverage.name: Notifications
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: In-app notifications plus budgeted transactional email; dedupe, priorities, opt-out and recovery-mail burst control.

scope_coverage.name: Content Management Backend
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Privileged content management, source provenance, staged imports, review/rollback and immutable release publication.

scope_coverage.name: Card Implementation Testing
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: CI qualification matrices, retained fixtures and bounded batch card simulations separate from production gameplay.

scope_coverage.name: Game Integrity & Anti-Cheat
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Private authority/RNG, validated frames, fraud/moderation evidence, rate limiting and secret/log redaction.

scope_coverage.name: Accounts & Infrastructure
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Accounts, private PostgreSQL, backups/restores, telemetry, maintenance, load balancing and protocol/release compatibility.

scope_coverage.name: Moderation & Administration
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Admin MFA/roles, investigation queues, reversible sanctions with audit and incident responsibilities.

scope_coverage.name: Developer / Debug Tools
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: Synthetic staging and authorized debug tooling; private exports/replays and capped simulation compute.

scope_coverage.name: Public API / Data Layer
scope_coverage.hosting_implications: All eleven public API/webhook/third-party requirements remain optional; scopes/rate limits/hosting budget added only if selected.
